name: ABAG v1.0
body:
Official v1.0 release of ABAG Mobile Application.

### Key Features
- High-speed automated USSD transaction execution (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money)
- Direct partner bank float settlement (Ecobank, GCB, Stanbic)
- Multi-branch teller cash drawer reconciliation
- Location-verified attendance geofencing & fraud prevention shield
- In-app Over-The-Air (OTA) updates directly from GitHub
